QuestInfo.name: Francis Spills the Beans
QuestInfo.0: #p1404000# is crying like a baby. This could slow down your information gathering efforts.
QuestInfo.1: Bring #t4033124# items to help fix #p1404000#'s puppet. Maybe it will make him stop crying. At least the #rGolems#k you have to fight won't be crying.\r\n\r\n#i4033124# #t4033124# #b#c4033124# / 40#k
QuestInfo.2: #p1404000# finally stopped crying long enough to talk. The Black Wings officers are attempting to bring back the Black Mage... and #m310000000# is their main source of energy. It still doesn't explain the Seal Stones though...

0.0: *Sniff sniff* My puppet's broke again... and I'm out of wood and string... I c-can't even repair my puppet now! Wahhhh! Wahhhhhhhhhhh!\r\n#L0##b(I guess I hit him too hard. It's going to be really hard to get the information I need.)#l\n#k
0.1: I don't care... I don't care about anything in the world! Nothing means anything if I can't fix my puppet! I want to curl up in a ball and cry until I die! Waaahhhhh!\r\n#L0##bGet yourself together, man! I'll get your idiotic puppet pieces if you stop that infernal wailing.#l\n#k
0.2: I don't care about anyth... You'll get stuff for me? This better not be a trick. I'll need the #b#t4033124##k... about #b40#k of them...

yes.0: You'll really get them for me? I'd go beat up the #rGolems#k myself, but I just don't have any c-c-confidence anymore.\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: I knew you were lying! Wahhhhhhh!

1.0: Y-you really got the parts for me? I don't know who you are, but you're not a complete idiot...\r\n#L0##bThat means a lot, coming from a sniveling toad.#l\n#k
1.1: What did you want from me, anyway? You just barged in here and started breaking everything.\r\n#L0##bTell me about the Black Wings. What do they want?#l\n#k
1.2: Y-you beat me up for that?! They want to bring the Black Mage back! Any lowlife on the street could tell you that! \r\n#L0##bWhat does that have to do with extracting energy from #m310000000#?#l\n#k
1.3: I don't know... #p2154002# said they needed energy to bring the Black Mage back. I don't know anything about it, I swear!\r\n#L0##bYou must know something. Why are they collecting Seal Stones? They should be useless.#l\n#k
1.4: Isn't that obvious? We have to collect all of the Seal Stones to bring him back! That's how it works! Duh! \r\n#L0##bYou'll stop feeding me false leads if you don't want another broken puppet. The Seal Stones don't have that kind of power.#l\n#k
1.5: N-no! I swear it! I was told we had to collect all of the Seal Stones to awaken the Black Mage! Why else would they have sent us out to find them?!\r\n#L0##bWho told you that?#l\n#k
1.6: Those orders came directly from the #rfounder of the Black Wings, Commander Or#k... No! I can't say anymore!

yes.0: I-I'm not telling you anymore! You can break all my puppets, but I'm not gonna do it!

item.0: *Sniff sniff* When will I get to fix my broken puppet? I'll need at least #b40#k #b#t4033124##k items... I can't get beaten up anymore and those #rGolems#k are too strong!
